description: A relative <base href="/foo/"> together with a ROOT-RELATIVE stylesheet href (which a base path does not affect).

thin.note: Spec <base href> handling replaces critical's regex-and-guess approach: a root-relative href is resolved against the base URL (origin /), so the sheet is found and the job succeeds. critical throws a TypeError ("path" argument) as soon as it has to resolve a non-absolute href while a relative <base href> is present.

expect.message: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined
